title: Test nested manifest detection

truths: a nested packages/app/Cargo.toml gives cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/app/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
a root manifest beats a nested one
a manifest three directories down or under node_modules, target or a hidden directory is not found
nested go.mod gives go -C <dir> test ./... from detect_commands
commands_notices names the nested clippy command when commands.test lacks clippy

Test names carry static_check (trust-layers C1) or nested_manifest. Use temp-dir repos and the existing static_check_repo helper where it fits. Assert observable output (command, source) only. If mmd-1 breaks the contract, return BLOCKED with the failing output instead of changing the production code. No code comments. Proof: the verify command; quote the counts and name the new tests.
